newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up, but gloom persists.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up, but gloom persists.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rebounded towards the close on Tuesday to end slightly up on short-covering in select blue chips, but dealers said overall sentiment remained weak.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 3.31 points, or 0.24 percent, to end at 1,358.89 from 1,353.17 at noon. Losers beat gainers 143 to 91. Fauji Fertilizer rose 0.85 rupees to 64.60.

"Trading was dull and only speculators were active in a handful of scrips. Sentiment will remain negative in the near term as there is no positive economic news," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
